# DTM Studio

Official website of DTM Studio.

DTM Studio is professional software for Single-Point Diamond Turning (SPDT), designed to generate machine-ready NC and PGM programs, apply profilometer and interferometer corrections, validate machining data, and manage complete precision optics manufacturing projects.

## Product

- Name: DTM Studio
- Status: Active Development
- Industry: Precision Optics Manufacturing
- Region: European Union

## Primary Capabilities

- NC / PGM program generation
- Profilometer correction
- Interferometer XYZ correction
- FeedX
- Loop Setup
- Multi-Trace surface generation
- 2D and 3D visualization
- Project management
- Production validation

## Supported Equipment

- Precitech
- Nanotech
- Laser Micro-LAM

## Official Website

https://dtm-studio.org/
